additional_context: Contract is active in the current build. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current active Contract search parameter bundle is internally consistent with the current Contract StructureDefinition, so changing names back to the historical DSTU2 topic/agent pattern would be wrong for the current specification.
